text:
marta: quick sync — started cross-codec bringup for nova-70b-mini. running hybrid int4/float16 codec + speculative prefetch. baseline float16, single model on p4d.
kai: nice. what batch/seq are you using? any warmup included?
marta: bs=8, seq=1024, 2k-step warmup. raw token/sec ~1.9x vs baseline on sustained runs. median latency ~65ms vs 120ms.
sandeep: wow on perf. what's the quality hit? any specific tasks regressing?
marta: summary: overall instruction acc -1.2% abs. QA EM -0.9, summarization ROUGE-L -1.4, hallucination rate +0.6% on our safety subset. peculiar spike on date-extraction prompts.
taylor: are you comparing symmetric vs asymmetric quant kernels? layerwise scheduling?
marta: tried 3 variants: symmetric-int4 (fastest, biggest drop), asymmetric-int4 (better quality, 1.6x), hybrid-6/4 schedule (promising). suspect KV-cache encoding noise in symmetric path.
kai: could speculative decoding be amplifying the regression? distribution shift in candidates.
marta: good point. speculative prefix caching gave additional ~1.3x when stacked on top of codec, but sample entropy increases slightly and calibration shifts.
ci-bot: run 5177777777/crosscodec finished: partial-pass. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/crosscodec/5177777777/{perf-summary.csv,eval-summary.json,transcripts.tar.gz}
ci-bot: perf-summary: median_tps: 1.92x, p95_latency: 1.1x improvement, tail variance reduced under warmup.
sandeep: we need stricter eval methodology note: speculative changes decoding distribution — offline metrics (ROUGE, EM) may not map to user-visible drop. propose 200-sample human pairwise on high-variance tasks (summarization, code-gen, date extraction).
marta: agreed. I'll kick off a crowdworker ablation: baseline vs codec vs codec+speculative. will attach seeds, tokenization, and run metadata.
taylor: pls include random_seed, tokenizer_version, and whether we used topk/top_p sampling during speculative rollouts.
marta: added metadata. also found a failing transcript for 'extract date' where speculative prefetch returned inconsistent tokenization for punctuation-heavy inputs — attaching snippet.

```
# run command
./run_perf.sh --model nova-70b-mini \
  --codec hybrid-int4 --speculative on \
  --bs 8 --seq 1024 --seed 42

# sample log (trimmed)
[INFO] warmup steps=2000
[INFO] sustained tokens/sec: 18500 (1.92x baseline)
[WARN] date-extract task: mismatch tokens=3 out of 120
```

marta: next steps: 1) run layerwise 6/4 bits schedule 2) human eval (200 examples) 3) calibration plots + confidence shift analysis 4) targeted regression triage for date-extract prompts.
kai: sg — let me know if you want me to run a quick microbench on A100 where kernel choices differ.
sandeep: also add ablation for speculative policy: early-sample vs threshold-entropy. hypothesize early-sample has less quality impact.
marta: will do. tagging results in the CI artifacts when ready. :eyes:
